description: Energy-only dropout-recovery script. This file is the single source of truth for everything the agent is allowed to say; it follows docs/energy-agent-script-and-checklist.md line for line (tests/script_tests.py checks every quoted line of that document against this file). Lines marked `derived` are the smallest possible acknowledgements the document requires but does not word (closing a call, re-asking a question more simply); no other text may be spoken. `demo_replies` and `state_demo_replies` are console quick-replies for the simulated-customer mode and are never spoken by the agent.

conventions.max_retries: Total capture attempts allowed for a field: the question plus three follow-ups (FIELD_FOLLOW_UPS in .env).
conventions.max_clarifications: Follow-up questions allowed per field before a person takes over: three, each worded more simply than the last.
conventions.readback_fields: Address, move-in date and energy are read back to the customer straight after they are captured, and only become valid once confirmed. Everything is read back again at the end.
conventions.placeholders: Text in {braces} is filled from the lead record or the journey. A missing value renders as 'not provided'; nothing is ever invented.
conventions.brevity: Keep the agent's lines short and generic. Follow-ups escalate: a brief re-ask, then the accepted format with a simple example, then the shortest nudge. Long lines are only for the document's own explanations (the opening, the read-backs). When the customer agrees to continue, the agent goes straight to the first missing question, with no lead-in.

steps.prompt: Hi {first_name}, this is the Energy Recovery Assistant from {brand}. You started comparing energy plans with us earlier. This call is recorded. Is now an okay time to continue where you left off?
steps.fallback_prompt: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Is now a good time to continue?
steps.fallback_source: derived, kept short: follow-up 1 is a brief generic re-ask (for the date, the document's own wording); follow-up 2 states the accepted format with a simple example; follow-up 3 is the shortest nudge
demo_replies: I'm a bit busy right now.
Can you put me through to a person?
fallback_prompts: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Is now a good time to continue?
Please answer yes or no. For example, say "yes" if now is fine, or "no" if it isn't.
Just yes or no, please.

steps.section: Journey milestone only. The customer's permission is asked once, in the opening; this step exists so a lead's last completed journey step can be mapped, and it is never spoken.

steps.no_retry_policy: A correction changes only the field the customer names, then the read-back is repeated once. If it is still not confirmed, a human takes over. Never loop.
fallback_prompts: Sorry, is all of that correct?
Please say "yes" if everything is right, or "no" and the detail to change. For example: "no, the date is wrong".
Just yes or no, please.

busy_callback_question.section: 1. Opening, recording disclosure, and permission (if busy)
busy_callback_question.text: No problem. Would you prefer a callback, or should I leave the journey for you to continue later?

busy_callback_question_again.section: derived: the busy question, asked once more
busy_callback_question_again.text: Sorry, would you like a callback, or shall I leave it for later?

busy_callback_closing.text: No problem, I have noted a callback. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

busy_later_closing.text: No problem, I will leave it for you to continue later. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

decline_closing.section: 1. Opening, recording disclosure, and permission (if they decline or ask not to be called)

handoff_human_request.section: 1. Opening, recording disclosure, and permission (if they ask for a person)
handoff_human_request.text: Of course. I will connect you with a team member and pass along what we have so you do not need to repeat yourself.

handoff_default.section: derived: any other warm transfer (frustration, repeated failure, low confidence, off-script or advice question, payment, dispute or vulnerability)
handoff_default.text: I will connect you with a team member now and pass along what we have.

handoff_life_support.text: Thank you for letting me know. I will connect you with a specialist team member so this is handled appropriately. You will not need to repeat the details you have already given.

eligibility_offer.section: 6. Concession status (if they ask whether they qualify)

submitted_closing.text: Thank you. I have submitted these details for the comparison journey. Your next steps will be sent by your preferred contact method. Is there anything else you need from a team member?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
